history.change_summary: Initial complete solution: preprocessing, LR one-hot baseline, LightGBM with native categoricals + 5-fold CV n_estimators selection, val comparison, threshold tuning, artifact saving, and FINAL-mode retraining on train+val for test prediction.
Adds CatBoost (native categoricals) and LightGBM to the mix and does an exhaustive subset-average + threshold search on validation for a stronger, more robust ensemble.
